MELBOURNE 2006 - XVIII COMMONWEALTH GAMES Gold at last for Phillips Idowu Injury and "failure to deliver" were put behind Phillips Idowu at last.

In qualifying group A of the triple jump, Phillips Idowu sailed through to the final with a second effort of 17.01 metres. Not so lucky was Frenchman Julien Kapek, in group B, whose best of 16.74 metres came with his third and last jump.

Phillips Idowu turned in a first effort of 16.82m and then confidently sat out the next two rounds in the belief that he had done enough and making sure that his previously bruised heel was not tested more than necessary.
